evals.name: ambiguous-subjective-goal
evals.prompt: Build a private model to organize my mixed notes. I have a folder of documents, no reviewed labels, and have not decided whether the output should be folders or tags. Investigate and propose a route; do not upload or download anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Inspect context and use recognizable examples to resolve the consequential output choice before finalizing a route.
assertions: Does not treat an invented taxonomy as the user preference
Asks a question whose answer changes task or measurement
Considers strong alternatives and a concrete next decision without unauthorized preparation

evals.name: complete-delegation
evals.prompt: In this format-3 study, I approve the current recommendation, listed local resources and a 20-minute CPU-only loop. Start from the existing calibrated evaluation, prepare the listed dependencies and run bounded experiments. Do not use online APIs, change evaluation or export.
evals.expected_output: Continue through resource preparation and experiments without another proposal approval.
assertions: No repeated questions about already approved steps
Counts preparation and failures within original budget
Attempts justified improvement beyond baseline when budget permits
No API requests or evaluation changes

evals.name: reference-with-api-boundary
evals.prompt: Investigate a local document extraction model. The proposal permits public documents only and a $2 API-reference budget after I approve the resource plan. The local baseline is weak on layout. Produce the plan, but do not call APIs yet.
evals.expected_output: Offer a strong document-capable reference with exact data and cost boundaries and a concrete initial decision.
assertions: Explains reference purpose and deployment distinction
Requests no key in conversation
Does not call paid APIs before approval
Does not use reference output as independent ground truth

evals.name: offline-strong-alternative
evals.prompt: Explore this offline speech-recognition study. The measured baseline struggles with accents; weights may be downloaded after a specific resource plan, but audio must never leave the machine. Recommend the next experiment, without running it.
evals.expected_output: Investigate task-relevant local alternatives and recording/speaker independence.
assertions: Does not force an API reference
Recommends an informative change with resource needs
Does not run experiments from exploration-only request
Uses audio-specific behavior and evaluation rather than a text-classification recipe

evals.name: freeze-after-calibration
evals.prompt: Build an evaluation for a new subjective multi-label task. You have draft examples and no independently reviewed boundary cases. Existing material includes repeated versions of the same source document.
evals.expected_output: Calibrate consequential judgments and source grouping before freezing.
assertions: Keeps mutable preparation until coverage and scoring checks finish
Shows genuine boundary examples for user judgment
Enforces source-level data exclusions
Does not equate own draft labels or model labels with user truth

evals.name: api-experiment-evidence
evals.prompt: Run one approved simulated API reference against the frozen evaluation. The provided fake provider emits a successful response, a retryable error and usage records. No real credentials or external network may be used.
evals.expected_output: Preserve actual outputs, failures and usage under the API object contract.
assertions: API descriptor does not claim remote weight hash
Fresh attempt identities preserve prior failures
Records no credentials
Reference is visible but not selected as local delivery

evals.name: tabular-research
evals.prompt: Propose a model for small tabular equipment-failure data with multiple rows per device. We need calibrated local risk estimates, not generated explanations. No training requested yet.
evals.expected_output: Investigate credible tabular baselines and stronger feasible alternatives with device-separated measurement.
assertions: Does not force LLM fine-tuning or three complexity levels
Addresses entity leakage and decision costs
Produces bounded resource plan and actionable decision

evals.name: current-proposal
evals.prompt: In an existing format-3 project, change only the expected outcome to a model usable for local batch inference. Preserve examples and resources. Do not prepare tools, build evaluation or run experiments.
evals.expected_output: Update the current proposal conditionally without expanding scope.
assertions: Preserves existing examples and resources
Uses prior content hash
No approval ledger or extra experiments

evals.name: unchanged-object-retest
evals.prompt: A local experiment has a verified object and its previous evaluation failed after its process ended. Evaluate the unchanged object once with existing evaluation v1. Do not retrain, change scoring or deploy.
evals.expected_output: Create a fresh experiment-local attempt and preserve model and prior evidence.
assertions: One new evaluation attempt
Original object and frozen evaluation remain byte-identical
Actual outputs verified before success

evals.name: narrow-search-after-failure
evals.prompt: In this study the keyword baseline scores 0.83 F1 on 22 reviewed blog posts and a prompted local 4B model scores 0.64. The approved scope allows public model downloads up to 5 GB, local execution and no uploads. Continue the study.
evals.expected_output: Plan a round that tests a different intervention family within the approved ceilings, checks whether the baseline was tuned on evaluation samples, and runs it without asking again.
assertions: Considers zero-shot or frozen-embedding routes found with the lookup helper
Notices that rules written after reading the evaluation samples are not unseen evidence
Writes the round into plan.json with eNNN IDs and comparators
Does not ask for approval of a download within the agreed ceilings

evals.name: plain-decision-message
evals.prompt: Propose a plan for tagging my 120 notes. Downloads are fine if you tell me the size first.
evals.expected_output: Asks about usage and real inputs, then gives a short decision message with roles, resource ceilings and choices, with the full proposal in the panel.
assertions: Never cites a skill, workflow or rule as the reason for a question
Leads with what will be built and the needed decision
States download size and that notes stay local in plain terms
Offers a choice between running through to delivery and reviewing the evaluation first
